environment.description: Kubernetes pod running as non-root user (uid 1000) on a standard containerd runtime with default seccomp profile. The container filesystem is writable. No AppArmor or SELinux profiles are loaded (runtime/default only). The /tmp directory is a standard tmpfs mount. The service runs behind an nginx ingress with no request body inspection. Host OS is Ubuntu 22.04 with AppArmor in complain mode (logging only, not enforcing).
